name: ai-fleas-workflow-router
description: Universal hidden Workflow Router lifecycle hooks for initialized AI Fleas endpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Runs the hidden Router contract for bound workflow tasks.
interface.longDescription: Loads receipt-backed workflow identity at session start and enforces a structured terminal Router result for every bound endpoint turn, independent of workflow name.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect the Workflow Router binding for this task.
